lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Guided practice B: qualitative graph interpretation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

items.prompt: A car accelerates steadily, then travels at a constant speed, then decelerates to a stop. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?

steps: While accelerating, the speed graph rises, so it is increasing.
While traveling at a constant speed, the graph is flat, so it is constant.
While decelerating to a stop, the graph falls, so it is decreasing.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt:
A graph shows height over time.
From t = 0 to t = 6, height goes from 19 to 16.
From t = 6 to t = 7, height goes from 16 to 20.
From t = 7 to t = 13, height goes from 20 to 20.
Which interval shows the height constant?
Consider the relation {(4, -4), (-9, -7), (7, 1), (5, -1)}. Is this relation a function?
choices: No, this relation is not a function.
Yes, this relation is a function.
It is a function only if every output is different.
Cannot be determined from the given pairs.

items.prompt: Which set of ordered pairs does NOT represent a function?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Given f(x) = 3x - 13, find the value of x for which f(x) = 2.

Function A is given by f(x) = 2x - 16. Function B is given by the table:
x: 3, 9
y: -35, -89
Which function has the greater rate of change?
choices: They have the same rate of change.
Cannot be determined from the given information.

items.prompt: Function B is given by f(x) = -2x + 12. Function A starts at 19 and increases by 3 each unit. Which function has the greater value when x = 0?
choices: Cannot be determined without a graph.
The two functions have equal values at that input.

items.prompt:
A table shows:
x: 0, 4, 8, 12
y: -17, 7, 31, 55
Is the relationship linear or nonlinear?
choices: cannot be determined from a table

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: Classify the equation y = -2x² + 8 as linear or nonlinear.
choices: cannot be determined from an equation

items.prompt: A function contains the points (-3, -4) and (-2, 0). Write the function rule f(x) = mx + b.
